final_assessment: Both remaining open questions settled under R-crc-3, and the exploration now has ZERO open questions and twenty decisions. D-rc04-16: a not-ready readiness record RECORDS and never blocks, on three independent grounds that agree — R-crc-10 says mechanize only what the engine can observe and readiness is judgement, so blocking makes the engine act on something it cannot verify; D-rc04-5 with D-rc04-3 as amended says Sal steers, and an AI belief that can veto Sal's archive inverts that exactly; and the archive already carries three stopping mechanisms, so a fourth adds a way to stop without adding a reason to. But record-only is not sufficient on its own, because exit (4) forbids a write-only record and it would be absurd to retire gate_overridden for that sin while committing it in the same stage — so not-ready gets two small real readers: the archive COMPLETION READOUT states it at the moment it happens, and orbit status --change surfaces the latest readiness record, which is what makes it visible to a cold session. Also settled where a not-ready record lives when the cadence routes to architecture and there is no archive: on the address-reviews emit that closed the final walk, the emit being written at that moment, so D-rc04-15's no-new-trail finding holds. D-rc04-17: gate_overridden is RETIRED from the write path rather than deprecated, and this was VERIFIED rather than assumed because exit (4) turns on it — it occurs in src/ only as a payload-field declaration in emit-composition.ts (the write gate accepting the key) and as prose in four workflow templates instructing bodies to write it. Nothing computes anything from it. A deprecation period exists to protect readers and there are none, so deprecating protects nobody. Readers of archived trails are handled by the existing D4 precedent at report-render.ts:178, which fails loud on a prior emit generation with a clean named error; gate_overridden records in archived trails are exactly that, readable as history and never written again. Nothing is lost, which is what makes the retirement honest: continuation/proceed carries gate, gate_state and gate_reason — the entire payload — plus the formed_against tokens it never had. Named the scope this creates rather than leaving it to be discovered mid-apply: four workflow templates instruct writing gate_overridden and all four need rewriting, which is body work in a capability rc04 does not otherwise touch and belongs in the size check before promotion.
